integrity: The lower bound and equality classification are proved directly and replayed by exhaustive finite enumeration with two equivalent Hall predicates. Literature comparisons distinguish the published optimum value from the equality census. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only for the t=1 combinatorial parameter (n,k,m)=(7,3,4); no claim is made for larger parameters, coded batch codes, erasure variants, or multiset-query variants. The published optimum value 12 is treated as prior work; the new content is the complete equality classification and counts.
title: Complete equality classification for the seven-item four-server three-retrieval combinatorial batch code
